name: Fostering
duplicates: Built inside Inspection in the old UI. The same move is also drawn in Farrowing as 'Foster piglets' (farrowing.foster, a one-stepper sheet); Piglet processing's Move piglets (piglet-processing.move-piglets, simple prototype) is a third version.

notes.purpose: Choose the kind of move: out of this litter, or into it, then the other crate.
states: Out of this crate (default), 'Likely - same age, smaller litters' suggestions
Into this crate: the other crate is the source
edge: A crate whose sow died may still receive: it is the only way to close its gain.
rules: Direction stays In whatever the litter's state.

notes.purpose: Choose the other crate by typing or scanning its code.
states: Typed code: 'Crates matching' list across units
This crate's own code: says why it cannot be chosen

elements.name: Crate in the picker
elements.shows: One row per crate matching the code.

states.when: match is a different litter in the same unit
states.shows: Unit, alive count and crate state
Unit shown; its state reads in the review below

states.when: the code typed is the current litter
states.shows: Says why it cannot be chosen

notes.purpose: Choose the piglets that move, by count or, for tagged piglets, row by row.
states: Which piglets: tagged piglets picked row by row (n of total, All), plus a count for the ones with no tag or notch
Questions per dose the source carries: 'did all n piglets have it?' Yes / No / Don't know

elements.name: Dose question
elements.shows: Asked per treatment the source litter carries, so Move records what the piglets had.

states.when: not all of them had it

states.shows: The receiver shows it to check against the spray mark

edge: A count past a sane litter size shows a warning (move-crowded).
The receiver's own piglets join too, and Move says so before Save (move-own).

notes.purpose: Check the outcome before Save: both litters' counts before and after, what the receiver still owes and what arrives done.
states: Out of this crate: same blocks
Save writes one move and returns to the litter drawer with a receipt

elements.name: Before and after
elements.shows: Each litter's alive count before and after the move.
elements.rule: Figures come from the ledger's draft of the move, so what is shown is what Save writes.

elements.name: Owed and Arrive done
elements.shows: The doses the receiver still owes the arrivals, and those they bring already done.
elements.rule: Figures come from the ledger's draft of the move, so what is shown is what Save writes.

rules: Receipt, then one Back to the drawer; there is no Moves page (R2-22).
